finding.comment: jobs_jsonl is written one object per line, but length > 0 assumes a single array document; on the first per-line object jq returns the object's field count, so the gate tests the wrong thing for this input format.

files.patch:
--- a/scripts/plan_gate.sh
+++ b/scripts/plan_gate.sh
@@ -5,4 +5,5 @@
 set -euo pipefail
+jq -c '.jobs[]' <<<"$plan" >>"$jobs_jsonl"
+test "$(jq 'length > 0' <"$jobs_jsonl")" = true
+echo "plan has jobs"
